n: Project GUTS Computer Science in Science
t: A middle school program that adds computer modeling to science classes.
steps: Open StarLogo Nova in a browser.
Confirm the current price and access terms with the program.
Look at the Project GUTS modules.
Join the Teachers with GUTS network.
Sign up for a workshop or an online course.
Ask IT to review account and privacy terms.
Try one module yourself before teaching it.
